title: Replacing Billy Moran in Manny Perez's band
summary: Dawson says Billy Moran was fired and he took his place in Manny Perez's band; they recall who else played in it. The band mostly did spot jobs at the lake.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: So I'll tell you why, they fired Billy Moran for me. Took me in the band, they had a falling out. Which band was that? That was that band they had to call it the... I don't see that band. Whose band was it? Who was the leader? Yeah. Wait now. Billy Moran and let me see who's the leader now. How you call him? He's a trumpet player. Good trumpet player too. Perez was it? Manny Perez. Manny Perez. Manny Perez. Who else was in that band? Do you remember that Eddie? Oh man, that's been Manny Perez, Billy Moran and George Beckhead. I think one of them boys we was just now talking about. Yeah, he was playing guitar. John Moran? John Moran? Yeah, he was playing guitar. John Moran? Yeah, he was playing guitar. John Moran? Yeah, he was playing guitar. Yeah, on drums. Remember that? No, let's see. I really can't think of who he had on drunk. When was it you played with Paris? You know, I just played while, you see. After Hifalight Charles Band or before? Yeah. Oh, after that. After that. Yeah. I didn't play with them long because they had a, after they had, they was playing spot jobs, you see. Most of their jobs were just like I say, out at the Karellas, out to the lake. Did Paris play mute it or did he play open horn? Yes.
